cases.name: AUP-05 one of two stale
cases.input:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: v1
    hooks:
    -   id: foo
-   repo: b
    rev: v1
    hooks:
    -   id: foo
cases.output:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: v1
    hooks:
    -   id: foo
-   repo: b
    rev: v2
    hooks:
    -   id: foo

cases.name: AUP-07 comments kept
cases.input:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: v1  # definitely the version I want!
    hooks:
    -   id: foo
        # These args are because reasons!
        args: [foo, bar, baz]
cases.output:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: v2  # definitely the version I want!
    hooks:
    -   id: foo
        # These args are because reasons!
        args: [foo, bar, baz]

cases.name: AUP-08 mixed endings
cases.input:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: v1
    hooks:
    -   id: foo
cases.output:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: v2
    hooks:
    -   id: foo

cases.name: AUP-09 flow style
cases.input:
repos: [{repo: a, rev: v1, hooks: [# A comment!
    {id: foo}]}]
cases.output:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: v2
    hooks:
    -   id: foo

cases.name: AUP-10 freeze
cases.input:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: v1.2.3
    hooks: [{id: foo}]
cases.output:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa  # frozen: v1.2.3
    hooks: [{id: foo}]

cases.name: AUP-10 unfreeze
cases.input:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa  # frozen: v1.2.3
    hooks: [{id: foo}]
cases.output:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: v1.2.3
    hooks: [{id: foo}]

cases.name: AUP-14 local first
cases.input:
repos:
-   repo: local
    hooks: []
-   repo: b
    rev: v1
    hooks: []
cases.output:
repos:
-   repo: local
    hooks: []
-   repo: b
    rev: v2
    hooks: []

cases.name: quoting of a retyping rev

-   repo: a
    rev: v1
    hooks: []

cases.name: quoting of yes
cases.input:

cases.name: rev at column 0
cases.input:
repos:
- repo: a
  rev: v1
  hooks: []
cases.output:
repos:
- repo: a
  rev: v2
  hooks: []

cases.name: D-DATA-10 freeze crlf
cases.input:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: v1  # note
    hooks: []
cases.output:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb  # frozen: v2
    hooks: []
cases.snp_output:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb  # frozen: v2
    hooks: []

cases.name: D-DATA-10 unfreeze crlf
cases.input:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb  # frozen: v1
    hooks: []
cases.output:
repos:
-   repo: a
    rev: v2
    hooks: []

cases.name: D-DATA-16 no final newline
cases.input:

repos:

    hooks: []
    rev: v1  # c
cases.output:
repos:
-   repo: a
    hooks: []
    rev: v2
cases.snp_output:
# keep me
repos:
-   repo: a
    hooks: []
    rev: v2  # c
